source: ProteomeCentral PROXI v0.1 per-dataset records, read via web fetch (compact fields only: title, species, instrument, keywords, announce_date). Descriptions are NOT included in this snapshot — the fetch layer available during assembly could not return long fields verbatim, and paraphrased text must never enter a deterministic-extraction corpus. Run `python -m pxenrich.ingest.run_ingest`-style live ingest (pridepy / PROXI API) from a network-enabled machine to add verbatim descriptions and refresh values; records are upserted by accession.
note: 10 REAL cardiac-vocabulary ProteomeXchange records found by targeted search on 2026-10-30, chosen to exercise every assertion state of rule:cardio-v0.1, plus 2 SYNTHETIC records (synthetic:true, CARDIO-DEMO-* accessions) that demonstrate the numeric-EF derivation (D1) and the EF-vs-term conflict rule (D4), which compact real metadata rarely states in titles/keywords. Synthetic records must never be cited as real datasets and are excluded from any corpus statistics.
corpus_scoping_todo: The quotable PRIDE cardiac-vocabulary corpus count (the grant 'N') is a ~1-hour pridepy task on a network-enabled machine; this 12-record seed is a demo slice, not the corpus.
